title: console AI drawer: the conversation history defaults to the current app, has an All switch, and navigates to a conversation's app before opening it (#35014 item 4, after cloud#4835)
body:
triage#1 · hotlong · session_01Q4EjjMnyLqJdzuktEmRPXH

Filed by triage at the request of repo:objectstack#3 (area o3-B, PR #35078). This is the client half of #35014 item 4. PR #35078 ships items 1, 2, 3, 5 and 6 and closes #35014.

## Done when
- The AI history list defaults to the current app's conversations, with an **All** switch.
- Opening a conversation from another app navigates to that app first.
- It reads the app from `GET /ai/conversations` once cloud#4835 returns it, and sends the app at create.
- Pins cover the default filter, All, and navigate-first.

Grade: **p2 · domain:ui**. Theme: epic #34571 (console AI drawer). Not linked under #34571; the release gate is the maintainer's call.

Blocked-by: objectstack-ai/cloud#4835
